articles.text: 学生: 赤坂見附はいくつ目ですか。 (Gakusei: Akasakamitsuke wa ikutsu-me desu ka?)
STUDENT: How many stops is Akasakamitsuke?
教師: 渋谷から二つ目です。 (Kyoushi: Shibuya kara futatsu-me desu.)
INSTRUCTOR: It is the second station from Shibuya.
学生: The second station.
STUDENT: The second station.
